title: APR business register: costed data-acquisition options

recommendation.reason: The free open data already covers companies. What money buys is preduzetnici plus an OPTIONAL contact-phone field whose fill rate is unmeasurable from outside. A free source found during this spike (kompanije.net) covers the same preduzetnik gap at a measured ~68% phone fill and 0 RSD. Harvest that first, then re-cost APR against the residual.
recommendation.blocking_measurement: Share of registered preduzetnici that filled in the optional Telefon field. Two free ways to get it, in order: (1) ~15 minutes of a human on pretraga.apr.gov.rs checking ~20 facade preduzetnici; (2) register the free Besplatni paket on portal-info.apr.gov.rs (5 subject views + 1 XLSX per month) to confirm the export carries a Telefon column at all.

decision_rule.phone_fill_ge_30pct: Buy Prosireni (36.000 RSD / EUR 307 / 12 months). 14,400 subjects/year covers the whole ~10,000-record preduzetnik gap in one year.
decision_rule.phone_fill_10_to_30pct: Buy Osnovni (18.000 RSD / EUR 153 / 12 months) and run 500/month against 43.31 -> 43.34 -> 43.39 in that order.
decision_rule.phone_fill_lt_10pct: Do not buy. APR is then an enrichment target list only, and kompanije.net beats it at that job for free.

decisive_finding_phone.question: Does APR data include phone numbers?
decisive_finding_phone.answer: YES, but the field is optional. When a business registers it, APR publishes it publicly.
decisive_finding_phone.quote_sr: KONTAKT PODACI DRUSTVA / Telefon 1.: Telefon 2.: Faks: Internet adresa: www. / Kontakt podaci nisu obavezan predmet registracije. Ukoliko se odlucite da ih registrujete napominjemo da ce isti biti javno objavljeni na internet strani Agencije za privredne registre.
decisive_finding_phone.email_quote_sr: ADRESA ZA PRIJEM ELEKTRONSKE POSTE / *E-posta: ... Adresa za prijem elektronske poste je obavezan predmet registracije.
decisive_finding_phone.mandatory_phone_exists_but_not_published: KONTAKT PODACI ZA PORESKU UPRAVU ... *Broj telefona (obavezan podatak) - collected for the Tax Administration, not registered and not published.
decisive_finding_phone.fill_rate: UNMEASURED. Renders only behind the reCAPTCHA-gated detail page or inside a portal account.

free_baseline.note: This is what money does NOT need to be spent on. It is also thinner than previously recorded: municipality only, no street address.

activity_codes.note: Core set CORRECTED vs the FUZZ-41 issue body, which proposed 43.31/43.34/43.91/43.99. 43.91 is the weakest (64 companies); the set omitted 43.39 (largest finishing bucket) and 43.29 (carries thermal/acoustic insulation).

activity_codes.preduzetnik_gap_method: 9,830 all-form records in the five core codes (kompanije.net /Srbija/ category pages) minus 2,290 active companies in the same codes (APR open data). Independently corroborated: the site's legacy /preduzetnici/ index counts 8,001 for the same five codes, agreeing within ~6%.

options.name: portal-info.apr.gov.rs - Besplatni paket
options.volume: 5 subject views/month, 1 XLSX + 1 PDF report/month, 1 subject monitored
options.phones_included: yes when the business registered one (optional field)
options.verdict: DO THIS FIRST. Zero cost, no card. Confirms whether the export carries a Telefon column at all. Not done in this pass: creating an account in the member's name is his call.

options.name: portal-info.apr.gov.rs - Osnovni paket
options.legal_basis: Odluka cl. 25 st. 1 t. 1 (ceiling 30.000 RSD) with the up-to-40% reduction of cl. 25 st. 2 applied
options.volume: 2,000 subject views/month; 30 XLSX + 5 PDF reports/month; 50 subjects monitored
options.verdict: Fallback if phone fill lands between 10% and 30%. 6,000/year covers ~60% of the preduzetnik gap in year one.

options.name: portal-info.apr.gov.rs - Prosireni paket
options.legal_basis: Odluka cl. 25 st. 1 t. 2 (ceiling 60.000 RSD), reduced
options.volume: 5,000 subject views/month; 50 XLSX + 30 PDF reports/month; 200 subjects monitored
options.verdict: RECOMMENDED IF BUYING. 14,400/year covers the entire ~10,000-record preduzetnik gap plus the company codes inside one licence year.

options.name: portal-info.apr.gov.rs - Poslovni paket
options.legal_basis: Odluka cl. 25 st. 1 t. 3 (ceiling 90.000 RSD), reduced
options.volume: 25,000 subject views/month; 60 XLSX + 30 PDF reports/day; unlimited monitoring
options.verdict: Oversized. The whole national target list is ~14,000 records; 180,000/year buys headroom nobody needs.

options.name: Specijalni aranzman / bulk extract (FTP, e-mail, medium)
options.price_rule: do 45,00 dinara po registrovanom subjektu, u zavisnosti od grupe podataka
options.verdict: REJECTED. More than 12x the Prosireni package for the same rows; loses even at a quarter of the ceiling.

options.name: Automatizovano izdavanje podataka (veb-servis)
options.price_rule: 7,00 RSD per subject initial load + 32,00 RSD PER SUBJECT PER MONTH for continuous change delivery + 7.500,00 RSD/month platform maintenance
options.verdict: REJECTED. Priced for banks doing continuous KYC monitoring, not for a sales list. The per-subject-per-month term is disqualifying.

options.name: Scrape pretraga.apr.gov.rs through a reCAPTCHA solving service
options.captcha_rate_basis: CapSolver ~$0.65/1k at volume (low end); 2Captcha published reCAPTCHA v3 $1.45-$2.99/1k
measured_blockers: WAF blocks honest identification. GET https://pretraga.apr.gov.rs/robots.txt with UA 'SerbiaFacadeLeadEngine-Research/1.0 (+contact: ...)' returns an HTML block page ('Pristup je blokiran! ... Attack ID: 20000021'). The SAME URL with a Chrome UA returns HTTP 200 and the body 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' - robots.txt permits everything, the WAF forbids anyone who says who they are.

POST /api/search/PrivrednaDrustva/PretragaNaziva -> HTTP 405; /api/searchNazivi -> HTTP 404. Never got past the method gate, so it is unconfirmed that a delatnost filter exists at all; the surfaced routes are name-oriented, which may make exhaustive enumeration by activity code impossible.
Legacy host gone: pretraga2.apr.gov.rs -> HTTP 403; /ObjedinjenePretrage/Search/Search -> HTTP 503.
It is a state agency's portal accessed against its own access controls.
options.verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED and NOT equivalent to Path A. The project's own compliance rule is 'identify the crawler honestly', and the WAF makes that impossible - Path B cannot be run without breaking it. Path A costs EUR 153-307/yr and carries none of this.

enrichment_estimate_if_apr_is_target_lis.confidence: LOW. The 8-15% website share is an assumption, not a measurement - the Sajt field was empty on every kompanije.net record inspected. Measure it on 50 records before relying on this.
enrichment_estimate_if_apr_is_target_lis.conclusion: The enrichment case alone does not justify the purchase. What the purchase would still buy at 0% phone fill is a register-grade frame for sole traders (legal name, municipality, activity code, status, maticni broj) - the classification ground truth and dedup spine that the open-data company file gives us for companies and nothing currently gives us for preduzetnici.
